units.source_text: ——送葬队伍再走一二百米就到达火葬场，这时候突然遇上了雨。

en.t: The funeral procession had only another hundred or two hundred meters to go before reaching the crematorium when it was suddenly caught in the rain.

units.source_text: 幸好走到一个好心的施主的家门前，灵枢也可以一起避避雨。

en.t: Fortunately, they had come to the gate of a kind patron's house, so the coffin could also be sheltered from the rain.

units.source_text: 雨还没有停息的样子，送葬队伍又非前进不可，

en.t: The rain showed no sign of stopping, yet the funeral procession had no choice but to move on,

units.source_text: 只好给大家准备了雨具，并用油纸覆盖着灵枢，运到了火葬场。

en.t: so rain gear was prepared for everyone, and the coffin was covered with oiled paper and carried to the crematorium.
